label_rules.section_pattern: ^make day-to-day money management the least of your business worries$

ignore.reason: PDF-derived tables (owner's manual, impact report, fee schedule): PDFs are not a rate source and these rows name no product
calculator chart series (Category | ... tables keyed by month, year, age or point number): computed values, not products
certificate calculator balance-over-time series: computed values, not products
credit card payoff calculator: computed monthly payment per payoff term, not a product

ignore.label_pattern: ^((current|new) (remaining interest|interest|payment|monthly payment|loan total interest)|with(out)? additional payments|cost of (buying|leasing)|loan term \d+( \$[\d,.]+)?|down payment|loan and trade in)$
ignore.reason: calculator comparison outputs (current vs new loan, lease vs buy, loan-term comparison, vehicle affordability): computed, not products
calculator payment and budget breakdowns (mortgage payment, home affordability, life insurance, savings budget): computed, not products
retirement calculators (Category | Roth IRA | Traditional IRA comparison on /personal/retirement and the IRA calculator, retirement-income inflation scenarios): computed, not products
repossessed-vehicle bid listing (year, make, VIN, minimum bid), not a loan product
